milestone.title: Phase 1: Foundation & Local Engines
milestone.description: Database entity definitions, view-models, and navigation graph creation.

deliverables.item: Room Database integration via KSP for persistent session history.
Theme and dark color palette (Deep Black & Neon accents).
Main entry activity and MVVM state bindings.

milestone.title: Phase 2: UI Polishing & Quality Integration
milestone.description: Implementation of adaptive designs, test coverage, and compiler version alignments.

deliverables.item: Live tunnel previews using isolated WebViews and Console Mirrors.
Resolved Compose layout styling bugs (draw.clip packages).
Configured Robolectric testing capabilities for offline state integration tests.
Successfully compiled full Gradle release applet.

milestone.title: Phase 3: Real-Time Developer Features
milestone.description: Extending diagnostic properties and multi-protocol tools directly inside the overlay.

deliverables.item: True WebSocket listening bridge for forwarding client-side console logs.
Interactive CSS/DOM inspector overlay for quick responsive debugging.
Network payload viewer to mirror and review loaded asset payloads.
QR Code generator to speed up scanning local dev host URLs.
Remote casting stream allowing secondary devices to monitor active testing frames.
